questions.question: Your eldest sister / lives in / a big city, / does she?
questions.solution: Use 'doesn't she' in place of 'does she'. Yahan sentence positive hai toh question tag negative banega.

questions.question: There will probably be a lot of fish in their nets, will there?
questions.solution: Use 'won't there' in place of 'will there'. Yahan sentence positive hai toh question tag negative banega. Isilye will there ki jagah won't there hoga.

questions.question: I am suitably dressed for the occasion, am I?
questions.solution: Use 'aren't I' instead of 'am I'. Yahan sentence positive hai toh question tag negative banega. Isilye am I ki jagah aren't I hoga.

questions.question: You have locked the gate, isn't it?
questions.solution: Use 'haven't you' instead of 'isn't it'. 'you' ke liye 'you' pronoun aayega jiske liye plural verb aayegi, sentence positive hai toh question tag negative hoga, isliye 'haven't you' option D sahi hoga.

questions.question: The medicines have arrived, isn't it?
questions.solution: Use 'haven't they' instead of 'isn't it'. 'medicines' ke liye 'they' pronoun aayega jiske liye plural verb aayegi, sentence positive hai toh question tag negative hoga, isliye 'haven't they' option A sahi hoga.

questions.question: She will have to go to another school when she moves from here, has she?
questions.solution: Use 'won't she' instead of 'has she'. Sentence mein do clauses hai 'She will…..school' tak main clause hai aur 'she moves……here' tak sub clause, question tag humesha 'main clause' ke according banta hai, 'will' ka negative 'won't' hoga, isliye 'won't she' sahi hoga.

questions.question: She is not ready for marriage, isn't it?
questions.solution: Use 'is she' instead of 'isn't it'. 'she' ke liye 'she' pronoun aayega jiske liye singular verb aayegi, sentence negative hai toh question tag positive hoga, isliye 'is she' option A sahi hoga.

questions.question: You will participate in the marathon, won't you?
questions.solution: No improvement

questions.question: The tree was uprooted by the storm last evening ,isn't it?
questions.solution: Use 'wasn't it' in place of 'isn't it'. 'tree' ke liye 'it' pronoun aayega jiske liye singular verb aayegi, sentence past indefinite tense mein aur question positive hai toh question tag negative hoga, isliye 'wasn't it' option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: You have my mobile number, isn't it?
questions.solution: Use 'don't you' instead of 'isn't it'. 'has/have' agar helping verb hoti hai toh negative question tag 'hasn't/haven't' se banta hai, lekin 'has/have' agar main verb ki tarah kaam kare possession banane ke liye toh iska negative question tag 'don't/doesn't' se banega, sentence mein 'have' main verb hai jo possession bana rahi hai, isliye iska question tag 'don't you' option A sahi hoga.

questions.question: We can't live without water, will we?
questions.solution: Use 'can we' in place of 'will we'. Yahan sentence negative hai toh question tag positive banega. Aur jo model verb question mein di gyi hai usi se question tag banega isilye 'will we' ki jagah 'can we' hoga.

questions.question: I imagine you have learnt a valuable lesson from this experience, didn't you?
questions.solution: Use 'haven't you' in place of 'didn't you'. Sentence mein 'I imagine' main clause hai aur 'you have…..experience' tak sub clause, agar 'I believe, I know, I imagine' aise main clause ho toh sub clause ke according question tag banta hai, isliye 'haven't you' option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: Neither of the workers was happy with the new legislation ______ ?
questions.solution: 'neither' subject ke according 'they' pronoun aayega aur 'neither' se sentence negative ho gaya isliye question tag positive banega, 'they' ke according plural verb aayegi, isliye 'were they' option D sahi hoga.

questions.question: Everybody should visit Agra, ______ ?
questions.solution: 'everybody, each, either, neither, nobody, anybody, anyone, somebody, all etc.' subject ke liye question tag mein 'they' pronoun aayega, sentence positive hai toh question tag negative hoga, isliye 'shouldn't they' option C sahi hoga.

questions.question: All of them have decided,____?
questions.solution: 'everybody, each, either, neither, nobody, anybody, anyone, somebody, all etc.' subject ke liye question tag mein 'they' pronoun aayega, sentence positive hai toh question tag negative hoga, isliye 'shouldn't they' option C sahi hoga.

questions.question: Anyone will Answer this question, ____ ?
questions.solution: 'anyone' ke liye 'they' pronoun aayega aur 'will' ka negative 'won't' hoga, isliye 'won't they' option C sahi hoga.

questions.question: None of us thought of doing it , ____ ?
questions.solution: 'none, nobody, anybody, each, either etc.' ke sath 'of' lagake 'first, second' person ki baat karoge, toh 'first, second' person ke according pronoun aayega, question tag mein subjective case likha jata hai, isliye yaha 'us' ka subjective case 'we' hoga, 'thought' se pata chal raha past indefinite mein likha hai jiska question tag 'did' se banta hai, isliye 'did we' option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: Nobody in the family believes Rakesh has paid the heating bill, _____ ? So, he needs some time to prove himself to be reliable.
questions.solution: Question tag generally main clause ke according banaya jata hai isiliye yaha nobody wale clause ke according 'do they' banega. Aapko class mein padhaya gya hai ki agar main clause mein 'I believe, I know, I imagine' ho toh sub clause ke according question tag banta hai, ye kewal tabhi hota hai jab subject 'I' ho, iss question mein subject 'nobody' hai.

questions.question: He _____ hard for the exam, didn't he ?
questions.solution: Sentence mein 'didn't he' question tag ke according verb aayegi, question tag negative hai toh sentence positive hoga, aur 'didn't' se pata chal raha ki verb past indefinite mein aayegi, isliye option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: The jury has taken its decision, _______ ?
questions.solution: 'the jury' collective noun hai jab tak collective noun mein hint naa ho alag alag hone ka toh isse singular maante hai jiske liye 'it' pronoun ka use karte hai, sentence mein 'jury' singular hai, isliye question tag 'hasn't it' option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: Let's go out for a walk, ____ ?
questions.solution: 'Let's' suggestion dene ke kaam aata hai iska question tag 'shall we' se banta hai, isliye option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: There are many boys in the ground ___ ?
questions.solution: 'there' yahan introductory subject hai aur iska pronoun there hi hota hai, sentence positive hai toh question tag negative banega isliye option C sahi hoga.

questions.question: The committee are divided in their opinion, ____ ?
questions.solution: 'committee' collective noun hoti hai lekin yahan their opinion se alag alag hone ka hint diya hua hai toh yeh plural hogi to iske liye 'they' pronoun ka use hoga, sentence positive hai to question tag negative banega isliiye 'aren't they' option C sahi hoga.

questions.question: She scarcely wants to do it, ____ ?
questions.solution: 'scarcely' se sentence negative ho jata hai toh iska question tag positive banega isliiye 'does she' option A sahi hoga.

questions.question: One should not waste time in life _____ ?
questions.solution: 'one' subject ke according question tag mein 'one' aayega, negative sentence ka positive question tag banega, isliye 'should one' option C sahi hoga.

questions.question: He used to play volleyball when he was in college,______?
questions.solution: 'used to' modal ko question tag mein 'did' mein change kar dete hai, isliye 'didn't he' option C sahi answer hoga. Note:- agar 'didn't' ki jagah 'usedn't' option aajaye toh 'usedn't' ko bhi answer maan sakte hai jab 'didn't' option mein nahi diya ho.

questions.question: They dare not challenge me for a fight,______?
questions.solution: 'dare/need' jab yeh modal/H.V. hote hai toh question tag mein aate hai, sentence mein 'dare' modal hai kyunki 'challenge' main verb hai, isliye 'dare they' option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: She should have married Rajesh,______?
questions.solution: Agar sentence mein 2-3 helping verb ho toh pehli helping verb question tag mein use hogi, isliye 'shouldn't she' option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: She has been teaching us since 2001,______?
questions.solution: Sentence mein pahli helping verb 'has' hai jiske according 'hasn't she' option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: He has a very big house,______?
questions.solution: sentence mein 'has' main verb hai jo possession bana rahi hai, isliye iska question tag 'doesn't he' option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: Your cousin (a)/ practises advanced photography techniques regularly (b)/ to improve his creative portfolio, (c)/ does he? (d)
questions.solution: replace 'does he' with 'doesn't he'. 'cousin' ke liye 'he' pronoun aayega aur 'practises' verb present indefinite tense mein hai jiska question tag 'do/does' se banta hai, sentence positive hai isliye question tag negative hoga, isliye 'doesn't he' sahi hoga.

questions.question: There will probably be a huge crowd (a)/ outside the stadium tonight as the organisers (b)/ are distributing free entry passes, (c)/ will there? (d)
questions.solution: replace 'will there' with 'won't there'. Sentence mein do clauses hai 'there will…..tonight' tak main clause hai aur 'the organiser……passes' tak sub clause, question tag humesha 'main clause' ke according banta hai, 'will' ka negative 'won't' hoga, isliye 'won't there' sahi hoga.

questions.question: I am supposed to submit (a)/ the revised assignment today, after carefully (b)/ analysing the teacher's feedback(c)/, am I? (d)
questions.solution: replace 'am I' with 'aren't I'. 'am' ka negative question tag 'aren't' hota hai, isliye 'aren't I' sahi hoga.

questions.question: You have taken proper safety measures in the laboratory today, such as wearing protective gloves and goggles, isn't it?
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'haven't you'. 'you' ke liye 'you' pronoun aayega jiske liye plural verb aayegi, sentence positive hai toh question tag negative hoga, isliye 'haven't you' option D sahi hoga.

questions.question: The new policies have been implemented successfully across all departments, isn't it?
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'haven't they'. 'new policies' ke liye 'they' pronoun ka use hoga, sentence positive hai toh question tag negative hoga, isliye 'haven't they' option A sahi hoga.

questions.question: She will have to submit all her pending assignments before the final review begins next week, has she?
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'won't she'. Positive sentence ka question tag negative banega, 'will' helping verb ka negative 'won't' hota hai, isliye 'won't she' option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: She is not comfortable speaking in front of a large audience during formal events, isn't it?
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'is she'. Negative sentence ka question tag positive banega, 'she' ke liye 'she' pronoun ka use hoga, isliye 'is she' option A sabse sahi hoga.

questions.question: You will attend the official briefing tomorrow morning before the training session begins, won't you?
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'No improvement'. Positive sentence ka question tag negative banega, 'will' helping verb ka negative 'won't' hota hai aur you ka pronoun you hi hota hai, isliye 'won't you' sahi hoga.

questions.question: The train was delayed for several hours because of a technical fault in the signalling system, isn't it?
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'wasn't it'. 'train' subject ke liye 'it' pronoun ka use hoga, 'was' helping verb ka negative 'wasn't' hoga, isliye 'wasn't it' option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: You have all the required documents for the verification process today, including your identity proofs and address records, isn't it?
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'don't you'. 'has/have' agar helping verb hoti hai toh negative question tag 'hasn't/haven't' se banta hai, lekin 'has/have' agar main verb ki tarah kaam kare possession banane ke liye toh iska negative question tag 'don't/doesn't' se banega, sentence mein 'have' main verb hai jo possession bana rahi hai, isliye iska question tag 'don't you' option A sahi hoga.

questions.question: We can't succeed in this competitive examination without consistent practice and proper time management, will we?
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'can we'. Sentence negative hai isliye question tag positive banega, isliye 'can't' ka 'can' ho jaayega, isliye 'can we' option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: I believe you have completed the draft of your research report after reviewing all the reference materials carefully, don't I ?
questions.solution: Correct answer is 'haven't you'. Sentence mein 'I believe' main clause hai aur 'you have…..carefully' tak sub clause, agar 'I believe, I know' aise main clause ho toh sub clause ke according question tag banta hai, isliye 'haven't you' option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: Neither of the applicants was informed about the change in the interview schedule, _____ ?
questions.solution: 'neither' subject ke according 'they' pronoun aayega aur 'neither' se sentence negative ho gaya isliye question tag positive banega, 'they' ke according plural verb aayegi, isliye 'were they' option D sahi hoga.

questions.question: Everybody should follow the safety guidelines issued by the authorities during large public gatherings, ____?
questions.solution: 'everybody, each, either, neither, nobody, anybody, anyone, somebody, all etc.' subject ke liye question tag mein 'they' pronoun aayega, sentence positive hai toh question tag negative hoga, isliye 'shouldn't they' option C sahi hoga.

questions.question: All of them have booked their tickets for the cultural festival that will be held in the neighbouring state next month, ____?
questions.solution: 'everybody, each, either, neither, nobody, anybody, anyone, somebody, all etc.' subject ke liye question tag mein 'they' pronoun aayega, isliye 'haven't they' option C sahi hoga.

questions.question: Anyone will support the initiative which is started by him to educate the poor children, ____ ?
questions.solution: 'anyone' ke liye 'they' pronoun aayega aur 'will' ka negative 'won't' hoga, isliye 'won't they' option C sahi hoga.

questions.question: None of us realised the importance of the safety instructions written everywhere at the construction site, ____ ?
questions.solution: 'none, nobody, anybody, each, either etc.' ke sath 'of' lagake 'first, second' person ki baat karoge, toh 'first, second' person ke according pronoun aayega, question tag mein subjective case likha jata hai, isliye yaha 'us' ka subjective case 'we' hoga, 'realised' se pata chal raha past indefinite mein likha hai jiska question tag 'did' se banta hai, isliye 'did we' option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: Nobody in the neighbourhood trusts the rumours that have been circulating on social media for the past few days, _____ ?
questions.solution: 'nobody subject' ke liye question tag mein 'they' pronoun aayega, aur 'trusts' verb present indefinite mein likhi hai jiska question tag 'do/does' se banega, 'they' ke according plural verb aayegi, isliye 'do they' option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: He _____ several practice tests over the weekend to improve his speed and accuracy for the upcoming exam, didn't he?
questions.solution: Sentence mein 'didn't he' question tag ke according verb aayegi, question tag negative hai toh sentence positive hoga, aur 'didn't' se pata chal raha ki verb past indefinite mein aayegi, isliye 'took' verb ki 2nd form option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: The council has announced its revised guidelines to ensure more transparency in the admission process, _____ ?
questions.solution: 'the council' collective noun hai jab tak collective noun mein hint naa ho alag alag hone ka toh isse singular maante hai jiske liye 'it' pronoun ka use karte hai, sentence mein 'council' singular hai, isliye question tag 'hasn't it' option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: Let's discuss the remaining points of the project in the meeting room, ____ ?
questions.solution: 'Let's' suggestion dene ke kaam aata hai iska question tag 'shall we' se banta hai, isliye option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: All of you were called by the principal to his office on Monday, ____ ?
questions.solution: 'all, everybody, anybody etc' ke sath 'of' lagake 'first, second' person ki baat karoge, toh 'first, second' person ke according pronoun aayega, question tag mein subjective case likha jata hai, lekin 'you' ka subjective objective case same hota hai, aur 'were' ka question tag mein 'weren't' hoga, isliye 'weren't you' option C sahi hoga.

questions.question: The police are investigating several leads to identify the main suspect involved in the recent robbery, ____ ?
questions.solution: 'police' ek plural noun hai jiske liye question tag mein 'they' pronoun aayega aur 'they' ke according plural verb aayegi, isliye 'aren't they' option C sahi hoga.

questions.question: She hardly speaks to anyone in the neighbourhood unless it is absolutely necessary, ____ ?
questions.solution: 'hardly' ka matlab 'naa ke barabar' matlab negative isliye question tag positive banega, 'speaks' present indefinite hai jiska question tag 'do/does' banega, isliye 'does she' option C sahi hoga.

questions.question: One should not make important decisions in life under any pressure, ____ ?
questions.solution: 'one' subject ke according question tag mein 'one' aayega, negative sentence ka positive question tag banega, isliye 'should one' option C sahi hoga.

questions.question: He used to visit his grandparents every summer vacation when he was a child, _____ ?
questions.solution: 'used to' modal ko question tag mein 'did' mein change kar dete hai, isliye 'didn't he' option C sahi answer hoga. Note:- agar 'didn't' ki jagah 'usedn't' option aajaye toh 'usedn't' ko bhi answer maan sakte hai jab 'didn't' option mein nahi diya ho.

questions.question: They dare not speak about this confidential issue openly, _____ ?
questions.solution: 'dare/need' jab yeh modal/H.V. hote hai toh question tag mein aate hai, sentence mein 'dare' modal hai kyunki 'speak' main verb hai, isliye 'dare they' option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: She should have informed her parents earlier about the situation instead of waiting until the last moment, _____ ?
questions.solution: Agar sentence mein 2-3 helping verb ho toh pehli helping verb question tag mein use hogi, isliye 'shouldn't she' option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: She has been working tirelessly on this project since the beginning of the semester to ensure everything is completed on time, _____ ?
questions.solution: Sentence mein 'she has….this project' tak main clause hai jiske according verb aayegi, isliye 'hasn't she' option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: Students ought to submit their research projects before the final review meeting, _________?
questions.solution: 'students' ke liye question tag mein 'they' aayega aur 'ought to' modal ka question tag 'oughtn't' se banega, isliye 'oughtn't they' option B sahi hoga.

questions.question: While finalising the (a)/ lengthy rental agreement, the landlord (b)/ requested the tenant to put her sign (c)/ on each page of the contract. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'sign' with 'signature'. 'sign' ki jagah 'signature' hoga kyunki 'sign' verb hoti hai aur 'signature' noun hota hai, sentence mein 'her' adjective hai jiske baad noun ki jarurat hai, isliye 'signature' noun sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: His elder sister has been (a)/ working in foreign for more than (b)/ five years, although she frequently visits home (c)/ to spend time with her parents. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'in foreign' with 'abroad'. Sentence mein 'in foreign' ki jagah 'abroad' aayega kyunki 'in' preposition ke baad object ki jarurat hai, lekin 'foreign' adjective hota hai, isliye 'in foreign' ko hatake 'abroad' adverb of place se bhi wahi meaning aayega, isliye 'abroad' sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: While conducting a practice session, (a)/ the English teacher advised the students to revise the grammar rules (b)/ thoroughly before attempting the practice questions. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'the English teacher' with 'the teacher of English'. 'the English teacher' ka matlab hoga 'angrej teacher', lekin sentence mein matlab chaiye 'english padhane wala teacher' jiske liye 'the teacher of english' sahi term hoga. Ex:- 'the german teacher' ka matlab 'aisa teacher jo Germany se belong karta ho'.

questions.question: Unless she doesn't submit (a)/ all the required documents her application (b)/ for the scholarship will not be processed. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'doesn't submit' with 'submits'. 'unless' ka matlab hota hai 'agar nahi' jisme 'not' pehle se hee hota hai, isliye 'doesn't' yahan superfluous hoga, isliye 'she' ke according 'submits' singular verb sahi hogi.

questions.question: He warned them that the boy (a)/ they were making fun of was his cousin brother (b)/ and that such behaviour would not be tolerated by him. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: remove 'brother' after 'cousin'. 'cousin' ke sath brother yaa sister ka use nahi hota kyunki 'cousin' pehle se hee noun hai, isliye 'cousin' ke sath 'brother yaa sister' superfluous hota hai, isliye yahan 'brother' nahi aayega. sentence mein 'boy' se pata chal gaya hai.

questions.question: You need not worry (a)/ because the finance department (b)/ has assured that it will reimburse back all the travel expenses. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: remove 'back' after 'reimburse'. 'reimburse' ka matlab hee hota hai 'give back, waapas lautana', isliye iske sath 'back' superfluous hota hai, isliye yahan 'back' nahi aayega.

questions.question: These programmes which play a crucial (a)/role in enhancing employment opportunities (b)/ in several underdeveloped regions. (c) No error (d)
questions.solution: remove 'which'. Sentence mein 'which' nahi aayega kyunki 'which' se adjectival clause bana hai jiski verb 'play' hai, lekin 'programs' subject ko verb nahi mili poore sentence mein, isliye yahan 'which' relative pronoun ho hata denge, jisse 'play' verb 'programs' subject ke liye verb ban jaayegi.

questions.question: A student who has worked consistently (a)/throughout the year he will surely perform well (b)/ in the final examinations that the university conducts annually. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: remove 'he' after 'year'. Sentence mein 'he' pronoun nahi aayega kyunki 'who….lekar…the year' tak clause bana hai, aur 'student' subject ki verb 'will' banegi, isliye yahan 'he' pronoun ko hatana padega, jisse 'will' verb 'student' subject ko mil paaye.

questions.question: The villagers decided to rebuild (a)/the old community hall again after (b)/ it got damaged in the heavy storm. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: remove 'again' after 'hall'. Sentence mein 'again' nahi aayega kyunki 'rebuild' ka matlab hee hota hai 'dubara banana', isliye 'again' adverb superfluous hoga.

questions.question: The athlete was very (a)/ strong enough to complete the entire marathon (b)/ despite the harsh weather conditions. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: remove 'very'. Sentence mein 'very' aur 'enough' sath mein nahi aapayenge kyunki yaa toh 'very strong' hota yaa 'strong enough', lekin aage infinitive likhna hai aur infinitive ke sath 'enough' sahi hota hai, isliye yahan 'very' ko hatana padega.

questions.question: The students are angry because (a)/ the passing marks have been increased to fifty percent (b)/ by the institution just before the final examinations (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: replace 'passing marks' with 'pass marks'. 'passing marks' ka matlab hota hai 'pass hote hue marks', lekin hume yeh kehna hai ki 'pass hone ke liye marks' isliye yahan 'pass marks' sahi term hoti hai, isliye 'pass marks' sahi hoga.

questions.question: They worked in (a)/ this remote village for a brief period of time (b)/ before shifting to the nearby town (c)/ to start their new business venture. (d)
questions.solution: remove 'of time' before 'period'. Sentence mein 'of time' nahi aayega kyunki 'period' ka matlab hee 'time' hota hai, isliye yahan 'a brief period' ke sath 'of time' nahi aayega.

questions.question: The coach forbade (a)/ the players not to (b)/ consume junk food during the training period (c)/ as it could negatively affect their performance. (d)
questions.solution: remove 'not'. 'forbade' verb mein 'not' pehle se hee understood hota hai aur iska matlab 'kisi ko kuch karne se rokna/mana karna', isliye iske sath 'not' nahi aayega.

questions.question: At the end of the semester (a)/ the professor will leave the institute (b)/ for his hometown with bag and baggage. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: remove 'with'. Sentence mein 'bag and baggage' ek adverb ki tarah se kaam karne wala structure hai, aur isse pehle preposition nahi aati, isliye yahan 'with' preposition nahi aayegi.

questions.question: The final report (a)/ should not exceed more than fifty pages (b)/ as the committee has instructed all researchers (c)/ to keep the documentation concise and precise. (d)
questions.solution: remove 'more than'. Sentence mein 'more than' nahi aayega kyunki 'exceed' ka matlab hee hota hai 'kisi cheez se jyada', isliye iske sath 'more than' superfluous ho jaayega, isliye yahan 'more than' nahi aayega.

questions.question: Rohit mentioned that (a)/ his company had recently signed a mutual agreement (b)/ with a logistics firm of Mumbai (c)/ to streamline deliveries across Maharashtra. (d)
questions.solution: remove 'mutual'. Jab bhi koi 'agreement' sign hote hai wo mutually he sign hota hai, isliye 'agreement' ke sath 'mutual' superfluous hoga. aur 'mutual' ko hatane se 'agreement' ke according 'an' article bhi aayega.

questions.question: Anjali doesn't hardly remember anything (a)/ about the chain-snatching incident (b)/ that took place when she was ten years old. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: remove either 'hardly' or 'doesn't'. 'hardly' ka matlab he hota hai 'naa ke barabar' isme pehle se hee 'not' understood hota hai, isliye 'hardly' yaa 'doesn't' mein se koi ek word aayega.

questions.question: The reason why many youngsters (a)/ fall for online investment scams (b)/ is because they blindly trust influencers (c)/ who promise unrealistic returns in a few days. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'because' with 'that'. Sentence mein 'because' ki jagah 'that' aayega kyunki 'reason' ka matlab he hota hai 'kaaran' aur 'because' ka bhi 'kaaran' matlab hota hai, isliye yahan 'because' ki jagah 'that' aayega kyunki yahan 'kii' wala meaning chaiye, general structure 'the reason is that' hota hai. isliye yahan 'because' ki jagah 'that' sahi hoga.

questions.question: He reiterated his point again (a)/ during the discussion hoping that the committee (b)/ would finally pay attention to his proposal. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: remove 'again'. 'reiterated' ka matlab hee hota hai 'say again, dohraana', isliye iske sath 'again' superfluous hoga, isliye 'again' nahi aayega.

questions.question: While travelling to Pune for an official meeting, (a)/ I came across by chance (b)/ an old schoolmate, Rohan, at the railway food stall. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: remove 'by chance'. 'came across' ka matlab hee hota hai 'kisi se achanak milna', isliye iske sath 'by chance(achanak)' superfluous hoga.

questions.question: Meera asked her brother (a)/ that why he had not attended (b)/ their cousin's engagement ceremony. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: remove 'that'. Sentence indirect speech mein likha hai, toh 'asked' verb ke saath 'how, why, where, when' yehi conjunction ka kaam karte hai, aur iss sentence mein do clause ko jodne ke liye ek hee conjunction ki jarurat hai, isliye yahan 'that' conjunction nahi aayegi.

questions.question: Kavya doesn't have sufficient enough savings (a)/ to manage her rent and groceries in Bengaluru (b)/ if she gets fired from her job. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: remove either 'sufficient' or 'enough'. 'sufficient' ka matlab hee 'enough' hota hai, isliye inn dono mein se koi ek ka use hoga.

questions.question: Muskan asked her brother (a)/ supposing if their train to Kolkata got cancelled due to heavy rains (b)/ what alternative route they could take (c)/ to reach there on time for the ceremony. (d)
questions.solution: remove either 'supposing' or 'if'. 'supposing' aur 'if' dono ek sath nahi aate, kyunki inn dono ka matlab same hota hai, isliye dono mein se ek hi lagayenge.

questions.question: Not until the results were announced (a)/ did she understand how well she (b)/ had performed in the examination. (c)/ No error (d)
questions.solution: No error. 'Until' as a conjunction aajaye toh verb ke sath 'not' nahi aata, lekin 'until' ko qualify karne ke liye 'not' aa sakta hai, 'not until' structure use hota hai.

questions.question: The investigation revealed the true fact (a)/ that the fire in the Surat textile market (b)/ broke out owing to faulty wiring (c)/ and negligence of shop owners. (d)
questions.solution: remove 'true'. 'fact' humesha bolte usi ko hai jo true ho, isliye 'fact' ke sath 'true' superfluous hai.

questions.question: While travelling to Lucknow (a)/ Priya got stuck for hours (b)/ as it suddenly started raining like cats and dogs (c)/ near the Barabanki highway toll plaza. (d)
questions.solution: remove 'like'. 'raining cats and dogs' ka matlab hai 'raining heavily' matlab 'mooosladhaar baarish', jisme 'cats and dogs' ka matlab 'heavily' hai matlab yeh adverb hai aur adverb se pehle 'like' preposition galat hogi.

questions.question: Radhika had prepared extensively for (a)/ her CGL mains but because she fell sick (b)/ on the morning of the (c)/ exam, she couldn't give the test. (d)
questions.solution: replace 'give' with 'take'. Sentence ka matlab 'wo test nahi de paayi', toh grammar mein iske liye sahi word 'take' hai, isliye yahan 'she couldn't take the test' sahi answer hoga.

questions.question: The HR representative informed the (a)/ applicants that the team would revert back (b)/ to each of them individually (c)/ after thoroughly examining all the submitted documents. (d)
questions.solution: remove 'back'. 'revert' ka matlab hee hota hai 'answer back', isliye iske saath 'back' superfluous hoga.

questions.question: While driving late at night on the (a)/ Ahmedabad–Vadodara Expressway he slowed (b)/ down his bike when he (c)/ approached near the police barricade. (d)
questions.solution: remove 'near'. 'approached' ek transitive verb hai jiske baad object aayega, isliye 'approached' ke baad 'near' preposition galat hai.

questions.question: Before leaving for his night shift (a)/ Raghav requested his neighbour to kindly (b)/ look after his elderly father who(c)/ had been feeling unwell since the previous evening. (d)
questions.solution: remove 'kindly'. 'requested' ke sath 'kindly' ka use nahi hota kyunki dono ka meaning same hota hai, agar 'requested' pehle likha hai toh 'kindly' hatana padega.
